CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS execution_target_schema_components (
    component_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    component_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (component_version > 0),
    checksum TEXT NOT NULL,
    applied_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    application_version TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE internal_daily_risk_calculations (
    calculation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    strategy_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    strategy_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (strategy_version > 0),
    deployment_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    instrument_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    trading_day TEXT NOT NULL,
    pnl_ready INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (pnl_ready IN (0, 1)),
    reason_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    calculated_at_ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
    calculated_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE INDEX internal_daily_risk_calculations_scope_idx
ON internal_daily_risk_calculations (
    account_id, strategy_id, deployment_id, instrument_id,
    trading_day, calculated_at_ts
)

CREATE TABLE internal_daily_risk_transitions (
    transition_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    strategy_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    deployment_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    trading_day TEXT NOT NULL,
    sequence_no INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sequence_no > 0),
    from_status TEXT,
    to_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    from_cleanup_status TEXT,
    to_cleanup_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    calculation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    occurred_at_ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
    occurred_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (calculation_id) REFERENCES internal_daily_risk_calculations(calculation_id),
    UNIQUE (account_id, strategy_id, deployment_id, trading_day, sequence_no)
)

CREATE VIEW public_daily_risk_calculations_v1 AS
SELECT
    calculation_id,
    account_id,
    strategy_id,
    strategy_version,
    deployment_id,
    instrument_id,
    trading_day,
    pnl_ready,
    reason_code,
    calculated_at_ts,
    calculated_at_utc,
    payload_json
FROM internal_daily_risk_calculations

CREATE VIEW public_daily_risk_transitions_v1 AS
SELECT
    transition_id,
    account_id,
    strategy_id,
    deployment_id,
    trading_day,
    sequence_no,
    from_status,
    to_status,
    from_cleanup_status,
    to_cleanup_status,
    calculation_id,
    occurred_at_ts,
    occurred_at_utc,
    payload_json
FROM internal_daily_risk_transitions
